description:
Shows where a vehicle's or a line's running costs come from. The game charges them at different rates depending on what the vehicle is doing, but shows only one "Running Costs" bar.

The rates are directly measured in game: driving or waiting en route (traffic, signals) 100 %, at a terminal (loading, unloading, waiting for departure or a full load) 40 %, in a depot 5 %. On top of that comes a surcharge for poor condition.

  • Vehicle window:A line showing the current maintenance cost, green at a reduced rate, orange while waiting en route at the full rate. Expand it for a table of the last 24 min of game time (one year at default calendarspeed): time share and cost per state, the condition surcharge and the sum.
  • Line window: the same table for all vehicles of the line under the income graph of the "Balance" card, with the amount the game booked for comparison.

Income per cargo type (0.2.0): under the cost table a second table shows the income of the same window per cargo type: items, income, income per item, on-time share and the capacity the consist offers for that cargo, plus a Result line (income minus running costs).

Maintenance fee (0.3.0): the window of a depot or maintenance building gets a card with the "Maintenance Vehicles" fee the building charged in the last default game year, the share of it that went to vehicles already in very good condition, and how much of that to vehicles another building also maintained. Expand it for the vehicles: minutes in the pool, fee share, condition at entry and now, other buildings. The rule, measured in game: every depot or maintenance building charges 25 % of the running costs of each vehicle inside its area that holds one of its slots, for as long as it stays, also at 100 % condition.

Pure UI change, so achievements remain enabled and the mod can safely be removed from save games.

Disclaimer: This mod was created with the help of LLMs but all code was reviewed and tested by me.

Changelog

0.3.1 (unreleased)

  • Improved performance and reduced save game size.

0.3.0 (2026-10-31)

  • Depot and maintenance building windows get a "Maintenance fee" card: the "Maintenance Vehicles" fee the building charged in the last default game year, how much of it went to vehicles that were already in very good condition (80 % and better), and how much of that to vehicles another building also maintained in the window. Expand it for the vehicles, sorted by fee: minutes in the pool, fee share, condition at entry and exit of the latest visit, and the other buildings (tooltip). A click on the name opens the vehicle window; its tooltip shows the full name and the line.
  • The fee rule, measured in game: every depot or maintenance building charges 25 % of the running costs of each vehicle inside its area that holds one of its slots, per second it stays, also at 100 % condition. The card does not change it; it shows which buildings mostly pay for healthy vehicles.
  • The "in depot" bar of the cost table uses a readable blue instead of a dark grey.
  • The sampler costs about 2 ms more per 3 s of game time on a save with 379 vehicles and 48 depots (18 → 20 ms on one simulation thread), see the README.
  • The saved cost history is rebuilt once on the first load with 0.3.0 (new state format).

0.2.0 (2026-10-22)

  • Income per cargo type under the cost table, for lines and vehicles: items, income, income per item, on-time share and the consist's capacity for the cargo; passengers as one row; a Result line (income minus running costs of the window).
  • Income is scaled to what the game booked on the line's or vehicle's account in the same window; the footnote says which. Without a readable account base prices are shown and the Result is "–".
  • A second game script collects the paid items (a few seconds behind the game); it changes no prices.
  • The saved cost history is rebuilt once on the first load with 0.2.0 (new state format).

0.1.1 (2026-10-21)

  • "1 vehicle with less data" in the singular.
  • The oldest part of the window is weighted against the data that actually exists there, so a history that started mid-bucket no longer under-counts for its first minutes with a full window.
  • A vehicle that lags a few seconds behind the others between two reads no longer flickers into "less data".
  • Less work per refresh in the windows; a state that keeps failing is rebuilt after ten attempts.

0.1.0 (2026-10-21)

  • First release: live "Now €X/min" line in the vehicle window with the current rate, state and condition surcharge; expandable table of the last default game year (24 min of game time) by state: driving, waiting en route, at terminal (40 %), in depot (5 %), condition surcharge, sum.
  • The same table for all vehicles of a line under the income graph of the line window's "Balance" card, with the amount booked by the game for comparison.
  • The history is sampled every 3 s of game time and saved with the game.

de.name: Betriebskosten aufgeschlüsselt
de.summary: Schlüsselt die Betriebskosten von Fahrzeugen und Linien auf in Fahrt, Warten, Terminal, usw.
de.description:
Deutsch

Zeigt, woher die Betriebskosten eines Fahrzeugs oder einer Linie kommen. Das Spiel berechnet sie je nach Zustand des Fahrzeugs unterschiedlich, zeigt aber nur einen Balken "Betriebskosten".

Im Spiel wird direkt gemessen welche Unterhaltskosten anfallen: Während der Fahrt oder beim Warten (Stau, Signale) 100 %, am Terminal (Laden, Entladen, Warten auf Abfahrt oder volle Ladung) 40 %, im Depot 5 %. Dazu kommt ein Aufschlag bei schlechtem Zustand.

  • Fahrzeugfenster: eine Zeile mit dem aktuellen Kosten, grün bei ermäßigtem Satz, orange beim Warten unterwegs zum vollen Satz. Lässt sich aufklappen für eine Tabelle der letzten 24 min Spielzeit (1 Jahr bei normaler Geschwindigkeit): Zeitanteil und Kosten je Zustand, Zustandsaufschlag und Summe.
    Unter der Kostentabelle zeigt eine zweite Tabelle die Einnahmen desselben Zeitraums je Frachtart: Stück, Einnahmen, Einnahmen je Stück, Anteil pünktlich und die Kapazität des Zuges für diese Fracht.
  • Linienfenster: dieselbe Tabelle für alle Fahrzeuge der Linie unter dem Ertragsgraphen der Karte "Bilanz", mit dem vom Spiel gebuchten Betrag zum Vergleich.
  • Depotfenster: Gebühr für gewartete Fahrzeuge und eine Anzeige fpr den Anteil an Fahrzeugen mit sehr gutem Zustand. Auch wenn ein Fahrzeug 100% hat fallen Kosten an, solange es im Bereich des Wartungsgebäudes ist. Eine Aufklappbare Tablle listet alle Fahrzeuge der letzten Zeit, wie viel Kosten sie verursacht haben und von wie vielen anderen Gebäuden sie ebenfalls gewartet wurden.

Reine UI-Änderung, Erfolge bleiben aktiviert und die Mod kann problemlos wieder entfernt werden.

Disclaimer: Die Mod wurde mit Hilfe von LLMs erstellt, der Code wurde von mir überprüft und getestet.
